subject.title: feat: add native inline widget support

question: Is the proposed native WebView isolation and capability-URL contract acceptable for rendering assistant-authored widgets across iOS, Android, and macOS?
rationale: Automated review found no concrete bypass, but permitting assistant-generated HTML in authenticated native app surfaces is a security and product trust-boundary choice requiring the responsible native and security owners.

options.title: Approve after boundary review
options.body: Have native and security owners verify navigation denial, per-widget state isolation, capability refresh, and renderer recovery, then merge after current-head checks pass.

options.title: Narrow the initial rollout
options.body: Enable only platforms whose isolation contract receives owner approval and follow with the remaining clients separately.

options.title: Pause native widgets
options.body: Keep `show_widget` on the existing Control UI and Discord paths until a stronger common native sandbox contract is available.

recommendation.title: Approve after boundary review
recommendation.body: Have native and security owners verify navigation denial, per-widget state isolation, capability refresh, and renderer recovery, then merge after current-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository guidance assigns this person both iOS and security ownership, the closest match to the cross-platform WebView trust decision.
